title: Office & Commercial Movers in Long Beach | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Commercial movers in Long Beach for Ocean Boulevard towers, Towne Center shops and airport campuses: a $50 COI and crews 8AM – 6PM, seven days a week.
heroTitle: Office & Commercial Movers in Long Beach
heroSubtitle: Ocean Boulevard towers, airport-area campuses and shopping-center stores moved in planned phases, with each landlord's certificate and loading hours sorted before the truck rolls

faq.question: Can the truck load from the yellow curb outside our Long Beach shop?
faq.answer: Yellow curbs in Long Beach allow a stop only to load or unload passengers or freight, from 7 a.m. to 6 p.m. every day except Sundays and holidays, so a truck may use one for loading in those hours. A store's full contents take far longer than a quick stop, though, and on Sundays the curb is not held for loading at all. We agree a lot space, rear access or another legal spot with your landlord during the survey.

faq.question: Our store is in Long Beach Towne Center. When can you load?
faq.answer: The center's tenant handbook allows loading through the docks and service corridors only before 11 a.m. on weekdays, and through the front door only before 10 a.m. for stores with no back entrance. Our crew starts at 8AM to use that morning window in full, and we ask management ahead of time how any remaining work should be scheduled. The COI we issue for $50 names the owner entity, Vestar and the City of Long Beach, as the handbook requires.

faq.question: Do you move offices in the Ocean Boulevard high-rises?
faq.answer: Yes. In a tower such as One World Trade Center, the freight elevator reservation decides when we can start, so we get the building's move rules and certificate wording from the property manager before confirming a date. The truck stands at the loading point the building assigns, not at a Downtown Core meter, where parking is capped at two hours.

faq.question: Can our Long Beach office move on a weekend so we lose no workdays?
faq.answer: Yes. Our crews work Monday to Sunday from 8AM to 6PM, so one phase can run on Saturday and another on Sunday, billed at the Friday-to-Sunday rate. We do not work overnight, so a larger office is split into phases that each finish by 6PM.

faq.question: Do you handle warehouse and flex-space moves near the airport?
faq.answer: We move the office side, shelving, boxed stock, files and break-room equipment of industrial and flex units, including those in Douglas Park. Single items over 300 lbs cost $150 extra and need a crew of three. Forklift work, pallet racking and industrial machinery are outside our service, so flag them at the survey and we will schedule around the specialist who handles them.

faq.question: How is travel to a Long Beach job billed?
faq.answer: Business moves are hourly with a 3-hour minimum. Drive time counts double for jobs more than 10 miles from our base, and jobs 30 or more miles away carry a 4-hour minimum; your written quote shows which rule applies to your two addresses. A $30 gas charge is added to each job.
